name: JorgeCastro
author: castromind

sections.description:
jorgeCastro is a WordPress plugin that connects your site to the jorgeCastro SaaS platform, allowing you to receive and publish AI-generated blog posts seamlessly.

Key Features:

  • Easy Connection – Connect your WordPress site to jorgeCastro with a single API key.
  • Auto Publish – Receive blog posts directly from jorgeCastro SaaS and publish them automatically.
  • Image Handling – Automatically downloads images from posts and sets featured images.
  • SEO Integration – Supports Yoast SEO and Rank Math for automatic meta tag assignment.
  • Flexible Status – Posts can be published, saved as draft, pending, or private based on your preference.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/jorgeCastro/ or install via WordPress plugin uploader.
  2. Activate jorgeCastro from the Plugins screen.
  3. Navigate to Settings → jorgeCastro to connect your site.
  4. Enter your API key from your jorgeCastro dashboard and click Connect Now.
  5. Start sending blog posts from jorgeCastro SaaS to your WordPress site!
sections.faq:
How do I get an API key?

Login to your jorgeCastro dashboard, navigate to Settings → API Keys, and generate a new API key.

Which SEO plugins are supported?

jorgeCastro supports Yoast SEO and Rank Math. SEO meta tags (title, description, keywords) will be automatically assigned when these plugins are active.

Can I control post status?

Yes! Posts can be set to publish, draft, pending, or private from the jorgeCastro SaaS when sending to WordPress.

Are images handled automatically?

Yes, all images in the content are automatically downloaded to your WordPress media library, and the first image can be set as the featured image.

  • Receive and publish blog posts via REST API
  • Automatic image downloading and featured image support
  • SEO integration with Yoast SEO and Rank Math
  • Categories and tags support
  • Flexible post status (publish, draft, pending, private)
